newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MOL official denies Hungary oil find reports.
newsitem.headline: MOL official denies Hungary oil find reports.

text.p: An official of Hungary's oil and gas company MOL Rt on Wednesday denied press reports that the company has found new reserves of oil around the south Hungarian town of Szeged.
"It would be irresponsible to speak of any finds at this point," the official told Reuters, adding that MOL is conducting seismic explorations at the site, near an existing oilfield at Algyo.
However, the official, who declined to be named, said future finds could not be ruled out. @
"It is logically conceivable that in the vicinity of a large field (at Algyo) further resources could be found," he said.
The Hungarian daily Nepszabadsag earlier this week quoted a MOL engineer as saying the company had discovered 20 to 30 million tonnes of oil equivalent.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange, MOL shares closed on Wednesday at 1,865 forints, up 45.
